newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shares end down as investors take profits.
newsitem.headline: Lima shares end down as investors take profits.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed lower on Wednesday as investors continued to take profits following last week's sharp rises.
The profit-taking was expected to bring the market down further on Thursday, they added.
Wednesday, the General Index fell 1.2 percent to 1,583.8 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index also dropped 1.2 percent to 2,105.9 points, according to preliminary stock figures.
Among leaders on Tuesday, the biggest losers were those stocks that had risen most sharply in the recent bull run, particularly brewery Compania Nacional de Cerveza (CNC).
"We saw a technical correction today - especially in CNC," said Juan Alvarez of local brokerage, Divisas y Valores.
CNC dropped 4.2 percent to 1.37 soles on 597,000 shares, while its sister company and the country's largest brewery, Backus y Johnston, dropped 2.49 percent to 2.74 soles on 519,000 shares.
Benchmark Telefonica del Peru continued to outperform the market as it remained stable at 5.77 soles on volume of 840,000 million shares.
In a total of 2,506 operations, 32 stocks rose, 44 fell and 30 were stable in volume of 28.2 million ($11.1 million).
